entities.summary: Heikki Johannes Ikola is a Finnish former biathlete. Together with his countryman Juhani Suutarinen he became dominant in the 1970s and the early 1980s. In 1975 he became double world champion in both the 20 km and the relay. He also won the sprint title at the 1977 and 1981 World Championships.
